title: The Independent Designer’s Research Department
author: RN Collins
rightsRule: Evidence leads; atmosphere never substitutes for provenance.

carouselA.title: The Independent Designer’s Research Department: the institutional sequence

frames.caption: An independent designer can operate a rigorous research department by making questions, sources, permissions, interpretation, counterevidence, and retrieval part of the studio rhythm.
frames.alt: Title plate for The Independent Designer’s Research Department.
frames.treatment: typography, rule, folio and domain color only

frames.caption: A less-remembered house remains researchable because its object record survives.
frames.credit: Brooklyn Museum Costume Collection at The Metropolitan Museum of Art; Gift of Marion Litchfield, 1950

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 01 · ASK — Can the question change the work?. Frame a bounded design or institutional question, a decision date, relevant communities, and evidence that would require revision. “Inspiration” is too broad to audit.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping can the question change the work? within The Independent Designer’s Research Department.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 02 · SOURCE — Can each reference be recovered?. Preserve creator, title, date, institution, identifier, canonical URL, access date, rights statement, excerpt limits, and local notes. Keep link-only records visible without copying restricted media.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping can each reference be recovered? within The Independent Designer’s Research Department.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 03 · INTERPRET — Where does fact end and judgment begin?. Write source description, studio inference, transformation, disagreement, and cultural-authority question in separate fields. This prevents an appealing object from being made to prove more than its record supports.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping where does fact end and judgment begin? within The Independent Designer’s Research Department.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 04 · RETURN — What did research change?. Attach the altered silhouette, material, process, refusal, claim, credit, or archive rule to the source trail. If nothing changed, record why the reference was rejected rather than laundering it into a mood board.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping what did research change? within The Independent Designer’s Research Department.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.caption: Formal research systems can privilege institutions that already catalogued their holdings and marginalize living, oral, community, or embodied knowledge. Rigor must include consent, compensation, cultural review, and the right not to extract—not only better metadata.
frames.alt: Counterpoint card for The Independent Designer’s Research Department.
frames.treatment: typographic quotation field; no decorative imagery

frames.caption: Create five exact source records and one counter-source.
